sources.label: 🥀 Morphe patches for apps which I love
sources.author: Brokenn
patch_list: Prevents server-deleted messages from being removed locally.
Keeps view-once and self-destructing media viewable forever.
Bypasses restricted-content gates and channel no-forward checks.
Unlocks premium feature UI and shows the premium badge on self only.
Prevents typing status from being sent to other users.
Stops sponsored messages from being fetched and shown in channels.
